{{Quote|The Ring-Yew, known as the Malachite, embodies the glow of knowledge, the sharpness of victory, and the transition of boundaries.}}
'''The Malachite''', also referred to as '''The Ring-Yew''', is one of the [[Hours]], linked with hour III, or 3:00am. Her [[Aspects]] are {{Lore|Lantern}}, {{Lore|Edge}}, and {{Lore|Knock}}. She is a God-from-Flesh, shrouded in mystery, and tales speak of her clandestine trysts with [[The Mare-in-the-Tree]] within the groves of the [[Mansus]]. The Malachite stands as a beacon of enlightenment, challenge, and transformative gateways.

In days past, the Ring-Yew harbored a deep affection for [[The Thunderskin|Thunderskin]]. Yet, in a tragic twist, he met his end at the hands of the [[The Red Grail|Grail]] — a sacrifice to broker peace with [[The Horned-Axe|Horned Axe]] following the tumultuous [[The Lithomachy|clash of the Gods-from-Stone]].
